description: Create and start a synthetic-data generation run (Step 20): rows generate on the org's LLM key, pass trust filters (dedup, benchmark-contamination scan, validators), route to human verification (accept/fix/reject against your acceptance criteria), and the rejection-sampling flywheel regenerates from verifier feedback. Requires synthetic:write + the public_api_synthetic rollout.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What human verifiers check every generated row against.

config.description: Run config {recipe: {kind: TEXT_GENERATION|CHAT_GENERATION|SELF_INSTRUCT|EVOL_INSTRUCT|MAGPIE|PREFERENCE_PAIRS|REASONING_TRACES|TOOL_CALLS|RAG_QA|IMPORTED, count, promptTemplate?, columns[], seeds?}, model?, budgetUsd?, targetAccepted?, maxRounds?, seed?, filters?}. For IMPORTED: columns declare the row contract, nothing else is required.

sourceMode.description: GENERATED (default): we generate rows from the recipe. IMPORTED (verify-only): your own pipeline made the rows — push them with opentrain_synthetic_push_rows; config.recipe.kind must be IMPORTED.

name: opentrain_synthetic_create_run
